{{Quote|Max, what's Hirken's title? His official corporate job-slot, I mean.''"<br />"''Vice-President in charge of Corporate Security, it says.|Han Solo and Blue Max|<ref name="HSSE" />}}
'''Vice-President in charge of Corporate Security''' was the title given to the [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] who oversaw the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]], as well as the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] this title was held by [[Mirkovig Hirken]]. He was [[Death/Legends|slain]] during the [[Liberation of Stars' End]].<ref name="HSSE" /> After his death, [[Assistant-Deputy Viceprex]] [[Ilm Vaz-Weplinn]] was given the position by the [[Executive Directorship Board]].<ref name="HSCSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
